welcome.title: Welcome 👋
welcome.body: This is your household's shared shopping list. Everyone can add items by voice through Siri, and see them here in real time.

addItems.title: Adding items 🎙️
addItems.body: Tell Siri "add milk to the list", or type it manually — the item is added and auto-categorized. Check it off once you've bought it.

organize.title: Organized by category 🗂
organize.body: The list is automatically split into categories, so it's easy to know what to grab on each aisle.

stock.title: Track your stock 📦
stock.body: The "Stock" tab tracks quantities at home. Low items are highlighted, and one tap adds them to the shopping list.

receipts.title: Scan receipts 🧾
receipts.body: Photograph a receipt or paste a link to a digital invoice — items and prices are extracted automatically, once you confirm them.

sharing.title: Lists & sharing 👥
sharing.body: Create temporary lists for events, and invite other household members to edit the list.
